start.title: [TODO:it] Beyond the Wilderness
start.text:
[TODO:it] You lead the flock past familiar hills.
A strange light flickers ahead.

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:it] It Will Not Leave You
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The light flickers brighter still.
You cannot pretend you did not see.

stone_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not Like That
stone_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Mockery suits a child, not a man.
Go and see with humility.

approach_mountain.title: [TODO:it] Toward the Mountain
approach_mountain.text:
[TODO:it] Horeb rises before you in silence.
The glow is on its slope.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] This sight is meant for you.

run_back_consequence.title: [TODO:it] You Cannot Outrun It
run_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The glow burns in your memory.
Return and see the truth.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You turn back to the slope.

call_jethro_consequence.title: [TODO:it] This Is for You
call_jethro_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] No one else is meant to stand here.
Go, and look.

see_bush.title: [TODO:it] It Burns and Is Not Consumed
see_bush.text:
[TODO:it] Flame wraps the bush. Yet it stands whole.
Nothing turns to ash.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You will see this great sight.
[TODO:it] This fire is not yours to stop.
[TODO:it] Do not turn from holy ground.

smother_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Do Not Touch
smother_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] This fire is not of your world.
Approach with awe, not hands.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Do Not Hide
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] What hides from you is also revealed.
Step into the light.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You step out from the rock.

voice_calls.title: [TODO:it] "Moses! Moses!"
voice_calls.text:
[TODO:it] A voice from the flame calls your name.
It knows you fully.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Bow First
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] You stand before holiness, not a man.
Answer with humility.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Answer Him
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He called your name aloud.
Do not leave Him with silence.

remove_sandals.title: [TODO:it] Holy Ground
remove_sandals.text:
[TODO:it] "Take off your sandals, Moses.
The place where you stand is holy."

refuse_sandals_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Obey First
refuse_sandals_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Comfort matters less than holiness.
Do as He asks.

argue_sandals_consequence.title: [TODO:it] He Decides
argue_sandals_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He is the one who calls it holy.
Kneel and obey.

hide_face.title: [TODO:it] I Am the God of Your Fathers
hide_face.text:
[TODO:it] "I am the God of Abraham, Isaac,
and Jacob." You hide your face.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] No man may see and live.

look_up_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Lower Your Eyes
look_up_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] His glory is more than you can bear.
Listen, do not stare.

see_affliction.title: [TODO:it] I Have Seen Their Misery
see_affliction.text:
[TODO:it] "I have heard My people cry in Egypt.
I will deliver them by your hand."

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Do not flee what He calls.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not by Your Might
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] It is not your strength that frees them.
Speak honestly.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Do Not Flee
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] You ran from Egypt once before.
This time, listen first.

i_will_be_with_you.title: [TODO:it] I Will Be With You
i_will_be_with_you.text:
[TODO:it] "I will be with you," He says.
"This shall be the sign."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Ask His name to tell them

bargain_consequence.title: [TODO:it] His Word Is Enough
bargain_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He has spoken. Trust the voice.
Ask only what is needed.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Ask His name to tell them

i_am.title: [TODO:it] I AM WHO I AM
i_am.text:
[TODO:it] "Tell them I AM has sent you."
The name fills the silence.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You hold it in your heart.

question_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Some Names Are Received
question_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] You will not grasp it with the mind.
Receive it with the heart.

accept_mission.title: [TODO:it] Go, Moses
accept_mission.text:
[TODO:it] "Go. Speak to Pharaoh.
Lead My people out of Egypt."

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] He will give you the words.

plead_consequence.title: [TODO:it] He Will Give the Words
plead_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Your tongue is not your strength.
His word will be on your lips.

another_consequence.title: [TODO:it] He Has Chosen You
another_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] It is your name He called by the bush.
You cannot pass it on.

stand_resolved.title: [TODO:it] You Rise
stand_resolved.text:
[TODO:it] The flame still burns. The bush still stands.
Your heart is no longer the same.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The road home is the road forward.
[TODO:it] You are no longer a shepherd of sheep.

return_sheep_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not Sheep — A People
return_sheep_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Your flock now is the children of Israel.
Turn toward Egypt.

ending.title: [TODO:it] Toward Egypt
ending.text:
[TODO:it] The desert opens before you.
God walks unseen at your side.
